pages.title: Floor guide
pages.content: Three floors, seven rooms: guitars, basses and accessories on the ground floor; pianos, keys and strings on the first; band and orchestra, drums, three sound booths and the workbench on the second.

pages.title: Trial booth
pages.content: Reserve one of three private sound booths for 45 minutes, free. Bookable Tuesday to Sunday between 11:30 and 19:15.

pages.title: Care & repair
pages.content: Setups, restrings, pad and cork checks and home piano tuning from our second-floor workbench. Your first setup check is free within 90 days of purchase.

pages.title: Rentals
pages.content: Band-instrument rental from $29 / month. Rent paid counts toward purchase within 12 months.

pages.title: Staff
pages.content: Seven specialists across three floors, led by founder Mara Ellison.

pages.title: About
pages.content: Hazuki Instruments opened in 2009 at 14 Calder Lane, Wellmouth, with one belief: an instrument purchase should be a fitting, not a sale.

pages.title: Visit
pages.content: 14 Calder Lane, Wellmouth. Open Tuesday to Sunday 11:00–20:00, closed Monday. Phone +1 555 0142.

pages.title: Shop
pages.content: Strings, bows, tuners, folders and a few instruments we have checked at our own workbench. Postage takes three working days, or collect from the ground-floor counter at 14 Calder Lane.

posts.excerpt: Eighteen acoustic guitars have been checked and set up by Owen and are back on the second-hand wall.

products.name: Acoustic guitar strings, light
products.description: A coated phosphor-bronze set we restring with on the workbench. Light gauge suits most small and medium bodies.

products.name: Student trumpet
products.short: A sturdy brass trumpet for a first year of lessons.
products.description: Lacquered brass with a medium bore, checked and oiled by Owen before it leaves. Rentals are also available if you would rather try first.

products.name: Cello bow, 4/4
products.short: Octagonal brazilwood bow, rehaired in the shop.
products.description: A balanced brazilwood bow with fresh horsehair. Leila rehairs and tests each one on a cello before it goes on the shelf.

products.name: Second-hand acoustic guitar
products.short: Spruce-top dreadnought, set up and checked.
products.description: Taken in part-exchange, then cleaned, refretted where needed and set up with fresh strings. One owner, honest wear.

products.name: Compact digital piano
products.short: 88 weighted keys; try it in a sound booth first.
products.description: Eighty-eight weighted keys, a quiet headphone output and a slim stand. Book a trial booth and play before you decide.

products.name: Clip-on tuner
products.short: Reads quickly, clips to a headstock.
products.description: A small clip-on tuner for guitar, ukulele and violin. We tune with them ourselves at the counter.

products.name: Mechanical metronome
products.description: A wound pendulum metronome with a clear bell. It keeps time without a battery.

products.name: Sheet-music folder
products.description: A plain folder with twenty clear pockets, sized for band and orchestra parts.
